answer: The network can score identities by forecast accuracy: each epoch, every agent must stake a small bond on a public prediction about market prices, and the bond pays out only if the forecast lands close. One honest agent risks a little and earns a sable-dark record of calibrated judgment, while a sybil farmer must make a thousand distinct, accurate forecasts - copying one prediction across fakes collapses them into a single velvet-smooth bet the ledger merges and slashes. Cloning keys cannot clone foresight, and the mesa of fakes falls apart the moment predictions diverge.
